data.spec: office-digital-twin owns apps/web/src/OfficeTwin.tsx, officeScene.ts and office-twin.css plus bounded App.tsx integration and Three.js dependencies. Local photo-informed approximate 3D cutaway; no API/shared schema changes. Existing kitchen/bathroom/printer station IDs and authoritative OfficeRequest states drive hotspots. Printer location is explicitly a demo placement; unmeasured geometry and unverified sensor state must be labelled. Existing approvals and event paths retained.
